steps.what: Choose professional meetings, conferences and workshops relevant to teaching needs
Attend training, practise methods and discuss implications with other teachers

tasks.design: Use existing {LMS} event listings and {CALENDAR} arrangements while retaining teacher participation. A generated summary cannot replace practice, discussion or attendance requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Competence develops through participation and application.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing listings can support selection without a new application.
tasks.still_hard: Decide which methods suit the classroom and practise them well.
tasks.human_edge: Ask questions grounded in actual teaching experience.
tasks.altitude: The teacher retains professional learning responsibilities and time.

evidence.claim: Summaries do not establish equivalent practical competence or fulfil attendance requirements.

assumptions: Event organisers supply descriptions; teacher reading and choice are counted in s1.
This boundary excludes administering the school-wide training programme.
No new system or workflow is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which training is required and which attendance formats are accepted
research_questions: Which workshops produce changes in classroom practice after a month?

incremental.description: No additional system or workflow maintenance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=15+85=100. Selection and professional learning remain unchanged; no substitution of reading for attendance is counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer standardized tests and interpret results

steps.what: Prepare standardized tests and verify administration instructions and pupil arrangements
Administer tests under prescribed conditions and record administration exceptions
Interpret authorized results to determine student strengths and needs
outputs: teacher interpretation of strengths and needs

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, the authorised test platform, and its prescribed scoring and interpretation materials. Keep test administration and interpretation with the teacher; introduce no AI scoring or student-placement decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results require contextual interpretation and administration conditions matter.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest describes open-question scoring pilots, but they do not establish suitability for this standardized test.
tasks.still_hard: Understand what a score supports and what it cannot establish.
tasks.human_edge: Combine results with direct observations and appropriate specialist advice.
tasks.altitude: Teacher authority over interpretation remains unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss learning needs evidenced by test results

evidence.claim: CheckMate suggests open-question scores in a small teacher pilot; the digest gives no standardized-test approval for this design.

assumptions: The test publisher or authorised scoring service produces scored results from completed responses under its current contract; its existing scoring time is unchanged and no saving is claimed for it.
Teacher checks roster and approved arrangements in s1 and records exceptions in s2; these are not assumed free structured feeds.
Any locally teacher-scored test retains its prescribed manual scoring; no improvement is claimed and no new software upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Which tests and scoring service are authorised
research_questions: Do teachers understand the uncertainty and administration caveats in each result report?

incremental.description: No new scoring model or integration to maintain

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=20+45+35=100. No saving is attributed to existing publisher scoring; preparation, administration and teacher interpretation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Plan class projects, field trips or visits and verify practical arrangements
Track confirmed permissions, resources and outstanding arrangements for the activity
Supervise experiential activities and guide students in learning from them

tasks.design: Configure a single activity readiness checklist in {PROJECT}, linking each confirmed arrangement to its evidence in {DOCS}. The teacher still contacts participants, checks permissions and makes the final decision before supervising the activity.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly comparing separate arrangement lists creates tracking work.
tasks.enabler_now: A configured checklist can present verified arrangements together.
tasks.still_hard: Risk assessment, access needs, uncertain arrangements and supervision.
tasks.human_edge: Judge readiness and help children connect experience to learning.
tasks.altitude: The teacher gains a clearer readiness view, with no additional booking or supervision authority.

evidence.claim: A native checklist can consolidate confirmed arrangements without automating risk judgement.

assumptions: Teacher produces activity_id, dates, location, contacts and confirmed arrangements in s1; full planning and liaison time is retained.

Parents or guardians provide permission forms through the existing process; their effort is unchanged. Teacher verifies and captures permission_status and source_reference in s2; that capture is included in its remaining time, never inferred from silence.
Missing permissions or unconfirmed arrangements remain visibly unresolved and are clarified manually. Test the existing school checklist before adding configuration.
This boundary excludes repeated drafting of the academic lesson outline; no automatic bookings, reminders to families or trip authorisation are introduced.
unknowns: Which permission and staffing rules apply
Whether a shared checklist already exists
research_questions: Can a single readiness view reduce list reconciliation without increasing status-entry effort?

already_counted.description: Read permission evidence and enter verified status

incremental.description: Update activity checklist fields when procedures change

approvals.approved_version: Teacher verifies the exact activity plan revision and dated readiness list before starting; changed location, participants or permissions require a new readiness check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional E1: B=100; R=30+11.25+55=96.25; gross=3.75%; minus 1 focal upkeep gives 2.75% net. Low: current checklist already consolidates arrangements. High: only list reconciliation shrinks; contact, permission capture, final readiness and supervision retain their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select report scope and verify source records for students and activities
Compile report tables and required record fields into the report draft
Write necessary commentary, verify the report and submit to administration

tasks.design: Use the native report template in {OTHER}, the pupil record system, to populate factual tables and existing approved text into {DOCS}. The teacher checks facts and writes evaluative commentary before approving the exact final report for administration.
tasks.previous_blocker: Copying factual record fields into repeated report layouts consumes preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing pupil records can support a configured query and report template.
tasks.still_hard: Select relevant context and ensure commentary does not overstate what records show.
tasks.human_edge: Explain patterns responsibly and decide what administration needs to know.

ambition.what: Review the same verified report view between formal reporting dates.

tasks.altitude: The teacher can generate factual drafts on demand; commentary and release remain theirs.

reach.task: Check report coverage and missing source facts
reach.learn: Trace report fields to authorised records

evidence.claim: ParnasSys offers pupil records and learning-goal tracking.
Using a query and template for factual report fields is a proposed deterministic design; native export support must be verified.

assumptions: S1 produces the exact pupil_ids, reporting period, record-category selection, source versions and verified activity references used by s2; its full 30% remains, including manual resolution of missing facts.

Original entries are created by teachers during record-maintenance work and activity recording, unchanged outside this report boundary. S2 consumes only existing authorised fields; if they are not available in a native query, compile manually with no assumed saving.
School administration supplies the required report layout and access rules; template configuration upkeep is counted. No model generates observations or commentary.
Test native report configuration before any custom integration.
unknowns: Which factual fields the native report can retrieve
How much current reporting is already templated
research_questions: Can every generated table cell be traced to the correct pupil, period and source revision?

already_counted.description: Write commentary, verify sources and approve submission

incremental.description: Check template changes against reporting requirements
Maintain query mapping and access controls

approvals.approved_version: Teacher approves the exact final report file including commentary, source-set revision and recipient; edits or changed recipients require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional E1: B=100; R=30+0+35=65; gross=35%; minus 2 focal upkeep gives 33% net. Low: report is already native or fields require manual compilation. High: factual copy-and-layout work disappears; source verification and commentary retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Factual report compilation can become automatic while the teacher retains testing interpretation, experiential supervision and professional learning.
reach: Coordinate evidence-linked activity readiness with administrators
Review report requirements and source traceability
role.ambitious_version: Generate verified factual report drafts more often and devote attention to commentary and classroom decisions.
